meta.title: U3 independent performance validation of the three-state comparability criteria
meta.instrument: verbatim port of research/panels/defect_injection.py (frozen thresholds; the archived file is read-only here and this script writes a NEW output)
meta.truth_source: synthetic w x K x pi generative worlds (U1_formalization.md section 7); truth labels come from the generator, never from the instrument

seeds.scheme: cell seed = base + 7919*rep + 104729*hash_stable(profile|seed_key); base worlds = base + 100003*rep (healthy) / +1000003 (tight); paired common random numbers across scenarios

healthy.note: well-powered regime; 5 sources incl. one small source (n=20, exercises n>=15 clause)

tight.note: population mirror of the real econ->psych panel (per-source n, E1, E2 from the 2026-10-15 read-only probe); E2 1.435%/4.480%, ref_avail 0.872/0.916, avg_edges_yr(end) 31.3

healthy|single_source_panel.dose_unit: leaves 1 of 5 sources in both windows

scoring.protocol: positive truth = defect injected (dose>0); predicted positive = instrument withholds COMPARABLE (PARTIAL or REFUSE); FN = false acceptance, FP = false refusal; truth 'void' worlds are UNKNOWN and excluded from FP/FN. 'bias' classes condition on the population-level level distortion induced by the injection (see cells.*.population): the criteria are a coverage/power gate, so cells whose induced bias is material but whose coverage margins survive are the informative misses.

5p.note: paired mirror (same seed): the frozen statistics have no channel separating a missing field from an empty list

10p.note: paired mirror (same seed): the frozen statistics have no channel separating a missing field from an empty list

50p.note: paired mirror (same seed): the frozen statistics have no channel separating a missing field from an empty list

refs_shuffled.desc: reference order shuffled within every paper

ids_shifted.desc: all work IDs shifted by a constant (consistent bijection)

nontarget_refs_appended.desc: 3 distinct non-target references appended to every paper with refs

target_pool_extended.desc: 500 never-cited works added to the cited-side pool

year_relabel_within_window.desc: publication years permuted within each window

null_vs_empty_raw_path.note: missing field (referenced_works -> None) vs explicit empty list, paired on the same seed; raw provenance is separable at the record layer, the frozen statistics are not

real_anchor.note: anchor only -- this is the corpus the criteria were built on; it is not evidence

calibration_check.note: population (infinite-sample) margins of the tight synthetic profile vs the measured real econ->psych panel under the same windows

single_source_panel.note: U1_formalization.md section 4 documents 'single-source citing side -> PARTIAL'; in the frozen order the REFUSE clause qualified_sources<2 is evaluated first, so the PARTIAL single-source branch is shadowed. Recorded as measured (audit finding 2 confirmed); no threshold was modified.

source_absent_both_windows.note: a source silently absent from BOTH windows leaves a consistently smaller panel; cross-window comparability is unaffected (no support gap), so a COMPARABLE verdict here is correct and panel-completeness is outside the criteria's contract.

limits: Synthetic DGP calibrated to / mirrored on one direction (econ->psych); cross-direction performance is not measured.

Per-source DGP is a hurdle (0 with prob 1-p, else 1+Poisson(e1/p-1)) matched to two observable margins (e1, p); it does not reproduce the full edge-count tail or any correlation between reference-list length and target propensity.
Defects are injected at the table level; real acquisition failure modes (ID resolution errors, deduplication, per-source coverage windows) are not simulated.
Truth labels are generative (an injection was applied); they are not an external adjudication of which doses *scientifically* matter.
Real-data anchor is the corpus the criteria were built on and is reported as an anchor, not as evidence.
UNKNOWN exists only on the truth side (void worlds); the frozen criteria themselves have no UNKNOWN output state.
